commands.command:
set -e; BASE=http://192.168.0.16; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Shelly.GetDeviceInfo" -o /tmp/lcl-device.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Script.List" -o /tmp/lcl-scripts.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Script.GetStatus?id=1" -o /tmp/lcl-script-status.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0" -o /tmp/lcl-switch.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Schedule.List" -o /tmp/lcl-schedules.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/script/1/diag" -o /tmp/lcl-diag.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
device=load('/tmp/lcl-device.json')
scripts=load('/tmp/lcl-scripts.json')
status=load('/tmp/lcl-script-status.json')
switch=load('/tmp/lcl-switch.json')
schedules=load('/tmp/lcl-schedules.json')
diag=load('/tmp/lcl-diag.json')
assert device.get('model') == 'S3PL-00112EU', device
items=scripts.get('scripts', []) if isinstance(scripts, dict) else scripts
script=next((x for x in items if x.get('id') == 1), None)
assert script is not None, scripts
assert script.get('name') == 'Local Climate Link Thermostat', script
assert status.get('running') is True, status
assert switch.get('output') is False, switch
assert isinstance(diag, dict) and diag, diag
if isinstance(schedules, dict):
    jobs=schedules.get('jobs', schedules.get('schedules', []))
else:
    jobs=schedules
assert isinstance(jobs, list), schedules
print('shelly_model='+str(device.get('model')))
print('shelly_firmware='+str(device.get('ver') or device.get('fw_id') or device.get('app')))
print('script_id=1')
print('script_name='+str(script.get('name')))
print('script_running=true')
print('relay_output=false')
print('schedule_count='+str(len(jobs)))
print('diag_keys='+','.join(sorted(diag.keys())))
PY
